raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--quantization mxfp8` on a bf16 checkpoint only has a Blackwell path; on Intel XPU every layer silently falls back to per-channel FP8.

## Modifications

On XPU, bf16 layers with K % 32 == 0 quantize to MXFP8 at load (sgl-kernel group-32 quantizer) and run oneDNN's block-scaled `torch._scaled_mm`; other layers keep the per-channel fallback, as on CUDA. `test_mxfp8_online_gemm.py` now also runs on XPU.

## Accuracy Tests

MXFP8 linear vs fp32 at Wan2.2-A14B 720p shapes: rel_l2 0.0375. Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 1280x720x81, 40 steps, with SageAttention V3: valid video, same scene as BF16 (PSNR 18.9 dB).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

1 Intel CRI card. Wan 720p linears (M=75600), quant + GEMM vs bf16: 1.23x (5120x5120) to 1.51x (FFN up). Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 1280x720x81, 40 steps, end to end with SageAttention V3: 1411.9 s -> 1274.8 s; transformer memory 26.6 GB -> 13.9 GB each.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -8,6 +8,10 @@
 block-scaled ``torch.nn.functional.scaled_mm``. Layers with K not a multiple
 of 32, N not a multiple of 16, non-bf16 params, or pre-Blackwell GPUs keep
 the per-channel fp8 path.
+
+On Intel XPU weights and activations quantize with sgl-kernel's group-32 UE8M0
+quantizer to e4m3 + row-major E8M0 [rows, K/32] scales, and the GEMM is oneDNN's
+block-scaled ``torch._scaled_mm``.
 """
 
 from typing import Optional
@@ -21,8 +25,10 @@
     mxfp8_quantize_swizzled,
 )
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8LinearMethod
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import current_platform
 
 _E8M0 = torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+_MXFP8_GROUP_SIZE = 32
 
 
 def mxfp8_scaled_mm(
@@ -48,13 +54,63 @@ def mxfp8_scaled_mm(
     )
 
 
+def _xpu_mxfp8_quantize(x: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    from sgl_kernel import sgl_per_token_group_quant_8bit
+
+    x = x.contiguous()
+    q = torch.empty_like(x, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    scale = torch.empty(
+        x.shape[0], x.shape[1] // _MXFP8_GROUP_SIZE, dtype=_E8M0, device=x.device
+    )
+    info = torch.finfo(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    sgl_per_token_group_quant_8bit(
+        input=x,
+        output_q=q,
+        output_s=scale,
+        group_size=_MXFP8_GROUP_SIZE,
+        eps=1e-10,
+        fp8_min=info.min,
+        fp8_max=info.max,
+        scale_ue8m0=True,
+        enable_v2=True,
+    )
+    return q, scale
+
+
+def _xpu_mxfp8_linear(
+    layer: Module, x: torch.Tensor, bias: torch.Tensor | None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    qx, x_scale = _xpu_mxfp8_quantize(x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]))
+    out = torch._scaled_mm(
+        qx,
+        layer.weight.t(),
+        x_scale,
+        layer.weight_scale.t(),
+        bias=bias,
+        out_dtype=x.dtype,
+    )
+    return out.view(*x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])
+
+
 class MXFP8OnlineLinearMethod(Fp8LinearMethod):
     def __init__(self, quant_config) -> None:
         super().__init__(quant_config)
         # SRTFp8Config(use_mxfp8) sets a block size; the fallback path loads bf16
         self.block_quant = False
 
     def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: Module) -> None:
+        layer.xpu_mxfp8 = (
+            current_platform.is_xpu()
+            and layer.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and layer.weight.shape[1] % _MXFP8_GROUP_SIZE == 0
+        )
+        if layer.xpu_mxfp8:
+            qweight, scale = _xpu_mxfp8_quantize(layer.weight.data)
+            layer.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(qweight, requires_grad=False)
+            layer.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(scale, requires_grad=False)
+            layer.input_scale = None
+            layer.mxfp8 = False
+            return
         layer.mxfp8 = (
             not self.use_marlin
             and can_use_mxfp8_swizzled(layer.weight)
@@ -78,6 +134,8 @@ def apply(
         x: torch.Tensor,
         bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
     ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if layer.xpu_mxfp8:
+            return _xpu_mxfp8_linear(layer, x, bias)
         if not layer.mxfp8:
             return super().apply(layer, x, bias)
         if isinstance(x, tuple):

@@ -3030,8 +3030,9 @@ def add_cli_args(parser: FlexibleArgumentParser) -> FlexibleArgumentParser:
                 "is supported for 'fp8', 'mxfp4' and 'convrot_int8' (ConvRot INT8 "
                 "W8A8; runs on SGLang's JIT-compiled fused ops on CC 9.0, 10.0, "
                 "12.0 and 12.1, else on comfy_kitchen; see "
-                "SGLANG_DIFFUSION_CONVROT_INT8_BACKEND). Other methods "
-                "('modelopt', 'modelopt_fp8', 'modelopt_fp4', 'mxfp8', "
+                "SGLANG_DIFFUSION_CONVROT_INT8_BACKEND), and for 'mxfp8' on "
+                "Blackwell and Intel XPU. Other methods "
+                "('modelopt', 'modelopt_fp8', 'modelopt_fp4', 'mxfp8' elsewhere, "
                 "'mxfp4_npu', 'modelslim') require a pre-quantized checkpoint. "
                 "Note: 'mxfp4' targets ROCm + MI350+ (gfx95x); "
                 "'mxfp4_npu' / 'mxfp8' target Ascend NPU (A5 series for mxfp4_npu)."

@@ -1,14 +1,22 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 """Online MXFP8 GEMM path (``MXFP8Config()`` on a bf16 checkpoint): load-time
 block quant, the prequantized (e4m3, swizzled scales) input from the fused
-SwiGLU kernel, and the per-layer fallback to the per-channel fp8 path."""
+SwiGLU kernel, the per-layer fallback to the per-channel fp8 path, and the Intel XPU
+oneDNN block-scaled path."""
 
 import sys
 
 import pytest
 import torch
 
-pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="CUDA required")
+_XPU = hasattr(torch, "xpu") and torch.xpu.is_available()
+_DEVICE = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "xpu"
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (torch.cuda.is_available() or _XPU), reason="CUDA or XPU required"
+)
+requires_cuda = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="CUDA required"
+)
 
 
 def _layer(
@@ -24,9 +32,10 @@ def _layer(
         params_dtype=params_dtype,
         quant_config=MXFP8Config(),
         prefix="mlp.fc2",
-    ).to("cuda")
+    ).to(_DEVICE)
 
 
+@requires_cuda
 def test_mxfp8_linear_matches_bf16_and_accepts_prequantized(request) -> None:
     if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] < 10:
         pytest.skip("cuBLASLt MXFP8 block scaling requires Blackwell or newer")
@@ -57,21 +66,46 @@ def test_mxfp8_linear_matches_bf16_and_accepts_prequantized(request) -> None:
     assert torch.equal(out_tensor, out_tuple)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not _XPU, reason="XPU required")
+def test_xpu_mxfp8_linear_matches_bf16(request) -> None:
+    request.getfixturevalue("single_process_model_parallel")
+    in_f, out_f, rows = 512, 384, 200
+    layer = _layer(in_f, out_f, bias=True)
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1)
+    weight = (torch.randn(out_f, in_f, generator=g) * 0.02).to("xpu", torch.bfloat16)
+    bias = torch.randn(out_f, generator=g).to("xpu", torch.bfloat16)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        layer.weight.copy_(weight)
+        layer.bias.copy_(bias)
+    layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    assert layer.xpu_mxfp8 and not layer.quant_method.accepts_mxfp8_input(layer)
+    assert layer.weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    assert layer.weight_scale.dtype == torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+    assert layer.weight_scale.shape == (out_f, in_f // 32)
+
+    x = torch.randn(rows, in_f, generator=g).to("xpu", torch.bfloat16)
+    out, _ = layer(x)
+    ref = x.float() @ weight.float().t() + bias.float()
+    rel = ((out.float() - ref).norm() / ref.norm()).item()
+    assert rel < 0.05, rel
+
+
 def _assert_aligned_layer_falls_back(params_dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
     layer = _layer(512, 384, bias=False, params_dtype=params_dtype)
     g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1)
-    weight = (torch.randn(384, 512, generator=g) * 0.02).to("cuda", params_dtype)
+    weight = (torch.randn(384, 512, generator=g) * 0.02).to(_DEVICE, params_dtype)
     with torch.no_grad():
         layer.weight.copy_(weight)
     layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
     assert not layer.mxfp8 and not layer.quant_method.accepts_mxfp8_input(layer)
-    x = torch.randn(200, 512, generator=g).to("cuda", params_dtype)
+    x = torch.randn(200, 512, generator=g).to(_DEVICE, params_dtype)
     out, _ = layer(x)
     ref = x.float() @ weight.float().t()
     rel = ((out.float() - ref).norm() / ref.norm()).item()
     assert rel < 0.05, rel
 
 
+@requires_cuda
 def test_pre_blackwell_aligned_layer_falls_back_to_channelwise(request) -> None:
     if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] >= 10:
         pytest.skip("requires a pre-Blackwell GPU")
@@ -94,7 +128,7 @@ def test_unaligned_layer_falls_back_to_channelwise(request) -> None:
     layer = _layer(16, 128, bias=True)
     layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
     assert not layer.mxfp8 and not layer.quant_method.accepts_mxfp8_input(layer)
-    out, _ = layer(torch.randn(4, 16, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+    out, _ = layer(torch.randn(4, 16, device=_DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
     assert out.shape == (4, 128)
